rows.title: Full Classic Detail
rows.description: Our Full Classic Detail package offers professional-grade care for drivers seeking quality without a full restoration. while this package includes rim and tire cleaning, it features an advanced SiO₂-enhanced hand wash and wax, providing a hydrophobic shield against Florida's harsh elements. — Interior carpets and seats are completely vacuumed with a spot shampoo, and high-touch surfaces receive precision treatment to restore clarity and cleanliness. Excellent for new vehicles seeking upkeep.
rows.exterior_description: The Classic Exterior Detail offers professional-grade protection against Florida’s demanding elements. This package features a thorough rim and tire cleaning followed by an advanced SiO₂-enhanced hand wash to remove surface contaminants. — We apply a high-quality wax to establish a durable, hydrophobic shield that enhances gloss and simplifies future maintenance. The ideal solution for preserving your vehicle’s finish and maintaining a clean, reflective aesthetic.
rows.interior_description: Our Classic Interior focus provides essential maintenance for drivers seeking a refreshed cabin environment without a full restoration. This service features comprehensive surface sanitization and a meticulous vacuuming of all textiles to remove debris and allergens. — High-touch surfaces receive a precision treatment to restore clarity, while we include expert spot shampooing to address minor spills and stains, ensuring a clean and comfortable interior for your daily commute.

rows.title: Full Premium Detail
rows.description: Our Premium Detail elevates your vehicle’s aesthetic through a comprehensive exterior decontamination. This package features hand-applied Carnauba wax to amplify paint depth and specialized headlight restoration for maximum clarity. — The interior receives an exhaustive revival, utilizing deep shampooing to lift grime from carpets and upholstery, while all vinyl and leather surfaces are meticulously cleaned, shined and conditioned to a refined, showroom-quality finish.
rows.exterior_description: The Premium Exterior Detail is designed to revitalize your vehicle’s aesthetic and structural integrity. This service features a meticulous hand wash and comprehensive decontamination, paired with a targeted buff & polish to address specific surface imperfections. We perform a specialized headlight restoration to ensure crystal-clear visibility, followed by a hand-applied Carnauba wax for a deep luster and an enduring hydrophobic shield against the elements.
rows.interior_description: Our Full Premium Interior Detail provides a deep clean designed to refresh every inch of your cabin. We utilize a high-performance deep shampooing process to lift heavy-seated grime and stubborn stains from carpets and upholstery, followed by a specialized headliner spot cleaning. Finished with premium leather conditioning and UV-protective plastics treatment, this service ensures a pristine, showroom-quality environment while restoring high-touch surfaces for all passengers.

rows.title: Full Luxury Detail
rows.description: Full Luxury preservation and aesthetic refinement. This elite service features a comprehensive paint decontamination process followed by the application of a 2-3 year professional ceramic coating to establish a permanent hydrophobic barrier. — The interior undergoes a meticulous restoration, utilizing specialized deep-tissue extraction for all textiles and concours-grade conditioners to revitalize high-touch surfaces, ensuring a pristine, showroom-quality environment.
rows.exterior_description: The Luxury Exterior Detail is a multi-stage commission focused on paint preservation and enduring defense. This process involves a comprehensive chemical decontamination followed by precision machine leveling to eliminate surface defects and enhance clarity. We culminate with the application of an elite Ceramic Coating, providing your vehicle with incredible gloss and a durable, hydrophobic barrier against environmental fallout and UV degradation.
rows.interior_description: Our Luxury Interior Detail is an elite maintenance service designed to preserve and protect your vehicle’s cabin at the highest level. This package features a deep-cleaning of all textiles and high-touch surfaces, paired with premium conditioners that shield your interior from UV damage and wear. It is the ideal choice for owners seeking a pristine, showroom-quality environment and long-term surface preservation for both driver and passengers.

We culminate with the application of an elite Ceramic Coating, providing your vehicle with incredible gloss and a durable, hydrophobic barrier against environmental fallout and UV degradation.
rows.interior_description: Our Luxury Interior Detail is an elite maintenance service designed to preserve and protect your vehicle’s cabin at the highest level. This package features a deep-cleaning of all textiles and high-touch surfaces, paired with premium conditioners that shield your interior from UV damage and wear. It is the ideal choice for owners seeking a pristine, showroom-quality environment and long-term surface preservation for both driver and passengers.

rows.title: Full Luxury Detail
rows.description: Full Luxury preservation and aesthetic refinement. This elite service features a comprehensive paint decontamination process followed by the application of a 2-3 year professional ceramic coating to establish a permanent hydrophobic barrier. — The interior undergoes a meticulous restoration, utilizing specialized deep-tissue extraction for all textiles and concours-grade conditioners to revitalize high-touch surfaces, ensuring a pristine, showroom-quality environment.
